title: Read how a run ended
heading: A Gap Stop Ends OPTIMAL; Every Other Limit Ends FEASIBLE or NO_SOLUTION_FOUND
cases: an OPTIMAL run has a plan, is settled, and names no limit
a FEASIBLE run stopped on a node limit has a plan, is not settled, and names NODE
NO_SOLUTION_FOUND on a time limit has no plan, is not settled, and names TIME
an INFEASIBLE run has no plan and is settled, since no plan exists
an OPTIMAL run whose bounds differ, stopped by a gap tolerance, is still settled
a FEASIBLE run whose solver did not say which limit names UNDETERMINED, not TIME
